### Power Point - Aug. 23, 2006
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-aug-23-2006-1417506.html
Passage: Nehemiah 3:2
Points:
- Cooperation among God's people is essential for any successful spiritual undertaking.
- Rebuilding the wall required people from diverse backgrounds and trades to work toward one goal.
- The builders chose not to bicker or question, uniting instead behind God's mission.
- Churches and families thrive when members function as team players following the Lord.
